    All Classes and Interfaces

    Description

    AddProductForm
    GUI form that allows users to input product details to be added to the database.
    Bill
    Immutable Bill record generated for each finalized order.

    DAO class for client related operations in the database.

    GUI window for managing client-related actions such as adding a new client or viewing, editing, and deleting existing clients.

    ManagementForm
    The main GUI window for managing clients, products, and orders.

    Business Logic Layer class for handling order related operations.

    DAO class for order related operations.

    GUI to place orders by selecting a client, a product, and entering the quantity.
    Product
    Model class for Product objects.
    ProductBLL
    Business Logic Layer for handling product related operations.

    DAO class for product related operations in the database.

    GUI window for managing product operations such as adding new products or viewing, editing, deleting existing products.
